facts.fact: The BLS reports a 2025 median pay of $35,530 per year for animal care and service workers.
The BLS reports a 2025 median pay of $17.08 per hour for animal care and service workers.
The median annual wage for animal caretakers was $35,360 in May 2025, according to BLS.
facts.quote: The median annual wage for animal caretakers was $35,360 in May 2025.

facts.fact: The median annual wage for animal trainers was $39,990 in May 2025, according to BLS.
facts.quote: The median annual wage for animal trainers was $39,990 in May 2025.

facts.fact: BLS projects employment of animal care and service workers to grow 11% from 2025 to 2035, which it describes as much faster than the average for all occupations.
facts.quote: Overall employment of animal care and service workers is projected to grow 11 percent from 2025 to 2035, much faster than the average for all occupations.

facts.fact: BLS projects about 69,400 openings for animal care and service workers each year, on average, over the decade.
facts.quote: About 69,400 openings for animal care and service workers are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

facts.fact: Animal care and service workers typically have a high school diploma or equivalent and learn the occupation on the job, and many employers prefer candidates with experience working with animals.
facts.quote: Many employers prefer to hire candidates who have experience working with animals.
